pr_title: [feat] parameterize hardcoded MLA dimensions to support GLM5-W8A8
source_quote: As far as I know, rms_norm is performed to `q_c(q_lora_rank)` and `kv_c(kv_lora_rank)`, why add `opParam.qkRopeHeadDim` here?

correspondence.review_quote: whx-sjtu 指出在 rms_norm 的计算中，`q_c(q_lora_rank)` 和 `kv_c(kv_lora_rank)` 已经进行了 rms_norm 操作，质疑为何还要额外添加 `opParam.qkRopeHeadDim`。作者通过 commit `b5e87ca` 修复了 RopeConcat DataCopy 中 srcStride 的硬编码 qkNopeHeadDim 问题，将硬编码维度替换为参数化值以支持 GLM5-W8A8 模型。

rule.description: 在 MLA（Multi-head Latent Attention）内核代码中，所有维度参数（如 qkNopeHeadDim、kvLoraRank、qkRopeHeadDim 等）必须从输入 tensor shape 动态推导，不得硬编码特定模型的值，以支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek V3、GLM5 等）。
checkpoints: 检查 kernel 代码中是否存在硬编码的维度常量
确认维度参数是否从 tensor shape 动态推导
验证 rms_norm 操作中使用的维度是否与实际操作对象一致
确认 DataCopy 的 srcStride 是否使用了正确的动态维度

antipattern.context: As far as I know, rms_norm is performed to `q_c(q_lora_rank)` and `kv_c(kv_lora_rank)`, why add `opParam.qkRopeHeadDim` here?

pattern.context: As far as I know, rms_norm is performed to `q_c(q_lora_rank)` and `kv_c(kv_lora_rank)`, why add `opParam.qkRopeHeadDim` here?
